legal_effect_notes: Section 31 is not an unrestricted statement that every factual or physical aspect of property is conclusively established by a folio.
The statutory fraud/mistake and rectification framework remains material.
A registry map should not be presented as conclusively determining every physical boundary question.
Case law can explain the operation of statutory conclusiveness but does not itself amend the statute.
